findings.text: The retained 64-cell cut batch brings the P100 whole step to 3,029 launches and 957.50 ms versus 14,427 launches and 635.24 ms at base; the live plan's 100-launch target is missed and wall time regresses 51%, with no H200 result to establish the 0.5 ms limit.
